title: Retail category profit vs orders
desc: Decision page on which categories drive profit and which only drive orders. Technology is 26% of orders and 58% of profit. Tables and Bookcases lose money.
long: Public Superstore order lines, 2009-2012, 8,399 lines and 5,496 orders. SQL decision query, Python check, and one Power BI page. Sales 14,915,601, profit 1,521,768, margin 10.20%. Technology is 26% of orders and 58% of profit. Furniture is 35% of sales and 8% of profit. Tables lose about 99,063. Bookcases lose about 33,582. Office Supplies is the order engine; binders carry the profit.

title: FinSight AI
desc: Financial-analysis agent that auto-generates investment reports from structured market data, with a RAG architecture pulling in external financial sources.
long: Financial-analysis agent that auto-generates investment reports from structured market data. Uses a RAG architecture that pulls in external financial sources and produces a full report in under 30 seconds.

title: Customer Churn Agentic AI
desc: End-to-end ML + LLM pipeline for predicting and explaining customer churn, pairing a gradient-boosted model with an LLM explanation layer.
long: End-to-end ML + LLM pipeline for predicting and explaining customer churn. An XGBoost model handles prediction while an LLM layer, served through FastAPI, generates human-readable explanations.

title: ResumeForge AI
desc: Web app that generates ATS-optimized resumes from a user profile in under a minute. Deployed and publicly accessible.
long: Web app that generates ATS-optimized resumes from a user profile in under a minute. Deployed and publicly accessible, built on the Anthropic API with a Streamlit front end.

title: DataOps AI (v1 & v2)
desc: Intelligent DataOps platform automating data quality checks and monitoring, now in its second iteration.
long: Intelligent DataOps platform automating data quality checks and monitoring, now in its second iteration with improved rule coverage and reporting.
